Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1. **Yes**, the description text is expanded inline (showing multiple lines of text) rather than being in a popup dialog.
2. **Yes**, the toggle link at the end of the description reads "**Show less**" (visible at the bottom left: "N less").
3. **No**, comments are not visible below the description in this view. The area below the description appears to be cut off or empty; there is no comment section displayed.
